name: Crude Flint
summary: Across the Wetlands, Mosshide gnolls carry Crude Flint to kindle fires with freshly hewn marsh timber. Their fires anger Rethiel the Greenwarden, protector of the marsh.

sections.title: Kindling in the Mire
sections.body: In the Wetlands, Mosshide gnolls use Crude Flint to strike sparks for warmth and to cook meat in the damp bogs. They cut down living timber for their hearths and bonfires. Rethiel the Greenwarden sees each spark as an assault on the marsh's natural balance.

sections.title: The Greenwarden's Retribution
sections.body: Rethiel the Greenwarden seeks to stop the Mosshide gnolls from cutting down the marsh's trees. He asks passing adventurers to take the firestones from the pack. Rethiel plans to smash each flint to dust and cast the fragments into the sea, so the gnolls can no longer burn the Wetlands' living wood.

faq.q: What is Crude Flint used for?
faq.answer: Mosshide gnolls use Crude Flint to strike sparks for warmth and cooking. Rethiel the Greenwarden asks travelers to gather the flints to stop the gnolls from setting living trees aflame.

Most adult and specialized Mosshide gnolls carry Crude Flint, including Mosshide Brutes, Trappers, Fenrunners, Mistweavers, Mystics, Alphas, and Gnawbone. Smaller Mosshide gnolls and mongrels do not carry it.

faq.q: Why does Rethiel want the flints destroyed?
faq.answer: Rethiel the Greenwarden is horrified that the gnolls cut down living wetland trees and burn the wood for warmth. He plans to destroy their flints and cast the shards into the sea, leaving them without a way to spark fires.

faq.q: Are these flints valuable for crafting?
aliases: can i use crude flint in blacksmithing
faq.answer: No. Crude Flint is a rough stone suited only to sparking a crude flame; it lacks the purity and shape smiths and engineers need.

angles.text: As a druid, you know that cutting down living plants for gnoll comfort offends the tenets of nature. Taking and shattering the firestones is a natural duty for a guardian of the wild.
